title: MRZ Paste Input
summary: Validates a passport MRZ (ICAO 9303 TD3) check digit by check digit and catches OCR slips before details reach a booking or KYC form.
description: Passport MRZ field (ICAO 9303 TD3) that validates each check digit and the composite, catches OCR slips like O for 0 and K for <, swapped lines, CRLF and stray spaces, proposes the likeliest fix for a bad digit, flags expired or soon-expiring passports, then fills the fields.
catches: Wrong check digits for number, birth date, expiry, personal number and composite
OCR slips such as O for 0 and K for <
Swapped lines, CRLF and stray spaces
Likeliest fix for a wrong digit, cross-checked against the composite
limits: Passports (TD3) only, not ID cards (TD1/TD2) or visas
Valid check digits don't prove the passport is genuine
Names in the MRZ are transliterated and may be truncated
a11y: Visible label; textarea has aria-invalid when invalid and is described by the result
Each check has an icon with role=img and an aria-label (checked, pending, failed)
Focus moves to the first fix after parsing
server: Re-validate the MRZ and verify identity through your KYC provider on the server; don't log full MRZ lines.

sources.label: ICAO Doc 9303 Part 3 (check digits, weights 7-3-1, modulus 10)
ICAO Doc 9303 Part 4 (TD3 lower line and composite check digit)

rules.note: Informational. Confirmed the 7-3-1 weighting and the composite over positions 1–10, 14–20 and 22–43. The soon-expiring threshold is a product choice, not ICAO.

stops: Helps catch misread passport details before booking
